summary: Firefox’s media backends gained broader hardware video support and more reliable color handling. Linux Vulkan Video decoding is being enabled and optimized for supported NVIDIA devices, while AV1 SVC temporal IDs, HDR formats such as BT2100PQ, wide-gamut video, and decoded color metadata are preserved more accurately across FFmpeg, VideoToolbox, Windows Media Foundation, and MediaCodec. Encoder and decoder state machines were also hardened to avoid edge-case failures, leaks, and unsafe process use.
